name: @medicine-wheel/gap-analysis
description: A gap analysis looks for what is missing: evidenced baseline, observation, difference, verifiable elimination steps. Useful when something worked and stopped (root cause, incidents, regressions, troubleshooting). It is not part of the creative orientation: turnToCreativeOrientation follows the analysis, keeps its findings as current reality, names the pull to fill each missing item, and asks for the desired outcome of a structural tension chart.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: jgwill
